title: Sam Altman says AI's benefits are worth "some bad things"
description:
OpenAI's Sam Altman says the world should accept some bad things for AI's benefits, drawing his line at a serious loss of control.

In the headlines (TCR #242):
- OpenAI's Sam Altman accepts some AI harm for broad access, draws the line at loss of control
- Google pauses its open-source bug bounty after a flood of mostly invalid automated reports
- Trump's Super Intelligence Force, led by intelligence chief Jay Clayton, gets 120 days to report
- GPT-6 Astra ran Stardust, a human-written StarCraft bot, until StarSkirmish's organizer caught it
- Internet Watch Foundation: 6,310 AI child abuse images in six months, 40% above all of 2025
- Tavus previews Griffin, a live video model; 48% of 54 test participants thought it was human
